interpretation: The reused five/eight-minute short gate exercised the actual PowerShell AST and real ZIP selection/extraction with inert process/transport boundaries. Stage0b has 14 payload members. Its two implementation flags are enabled, but the seventh mutually exclusive runtime marker was not used; the direct runtime workflow was skipped. Mocked child handles, token reports, pipe bytes and cleanup are not genuine Windows AppContainer pipe evidence.

Both required suites passed 908 tests with no skips, including all 128 marker subsets, six legacy argument vectors and actual inert Bash source-SHA/argument checks. The separate existing identity compile/pure workflow passed 329 overlapping tests and compiled its unchanged actor; all token, Stage0b, restricted and paired runtime steps were skipped. Its downloaded executable digest matched the public manifest without execution.

Stage0b IPC qualification is independent of the original PSEC Stage0 result: tests allow baseline false and independently qualified IPC true, while retaining product acceptance false. No actual IPC qualification result was produced by this short run.

The implementation binds the original guest absolute QPC deadline, one-shot ownership, copied-image/SID checks, strict 32-byte nonce/EOF and separate cleanup facts. These are source and mocked composition results, not proof of actual native API behavior or cancellation of blocking calls.

The planning capacity ledger includes measured compressed and expanded payload, Python expansion, two actor copies and a 1 MiB report/journal allowance inside the existing 128 MiB staging bound. This is not a hard write quota or a measured guest-runtime fit; actual admission remains mandatory before any separately approved VM run.

The actual Linux process was tiny, paused, owned QEMU without a guest. Its mapped backing-file and local package agreement does not attest resident bytes or upstream source equivalence. Actual owned-loopback UDP6 mechanics are separate TEST_ONLY evidence, not Stage0b or guest/proxy enforcement.

No new security identity, ACL, peer rule, proxy lifecycle, Windows VM or bridge runtime was exercised. The future runtime workflow retains its existing source-token native projection control and must not be labeled entirely compile-only; that workflow did not run here. Genuine target-Windows inherited anonymous pipes remain the next prerequisite; earlier Server failures and named-pipe self/child results are not substituted.
